user_story: As a guest, I want to cancel my booking so that I can free up the reservation.

positive.title: Successful cancellation of a booking
steps: Navigate to the booking management page.
Select the booking to be canceled.
Confirm the cancellation in the prompt.
positive.expected_result: The booking is canceled successfully, and the user receives a confirmation message.

negative.title: Attempt to cancel a non-existent booking
steps: Navigate to the booking management page.
Attempt to select a booking that does not exist.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the booking does not exist.

edge.title: Cancellation of a booking that is already canceled
steps: Navigate to the booking management page.
Select a booking that has already been canceled.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the booking has already been canceled.
